name.label: Site display name
name.description: The name shown across the platform; the product name itself lives in brand.ts.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.description: Default IANA time zone used by business-hours logic.

locale.label: Default site locale
locale.description: Locale used when a user has not picked one of their own.

provider.label: SMS provider
provider.description: The active SMS driver; “fake” is for development only.

password.label: Melipayamak password
password.description: Password of the Melipayamak account (stored encrypted).

sender.label: Melipayamak sender number
sender.description: The sending line configured in Melipayamak.

otpBodyId.label: Melipayamak OTP body ID
otpBodyId.description: Template ID for OTP messages in Melipayamak.

apiKey.label: Kavenegar API key
apiKey.description: API key of the Kavenegar account (stored encrypted).

sender.label: Kavenegar sender number
sender.description: Sending line in Kavenegar; empty means the account default.

otpTemplate.label: Kavenegar OTP template
otpTemplate.description: Name of the OTP lookup template in Kavenegar.

length.label: OTP length
length.description: Number of digits in the code (4 to 8).

ttlSec.label: OTP validity (seconds)
ttlSec.description: How long a one-time code stays valid after it is sent.

maxAttempts.label: Max attempts per code
maxAttempts.description: How many times a code can be entered incorrectly.

host.label: SMTP host
host.description: Hostname of the outgoing mail server.

port.label: SMTP port
port.description: Port used to reach the mail server (usually 587 or 465).

user.label: SMTP username
user.description: Username used to sign in to the mail server.

password.label: SMTP password
password.description: Password of the mail account (stored encrypted).

address.label: From address
address.description: Email address messages are sent from.

name.label: From name
name.description: Display name shown next to the from address.

clientId.label: Google client ID
clientId.description: The OAuth client ID from the Google console.

clientSecret.label: Google client secret
clientSecret.description: The OAuth client secret from the Google console (stored encrypted).
